name: spill-local
description: The spill@1 provider `local-disk`: oversized payloads written ONCE to a content-addressed file on the workbench host, read back by byte RANGE, with the retention policy (max age / max total bytes / purge) owned here. Declares execution/policies because it writes to host paths directly.

config.description: Where spill files live, how large one payload may be, and how long they are kept.

dir.description: Directory spill files live in (default: <tmpdir>/workbench-spill). Every path a call names is confined to it.

maxBytes.description: Byte ceiling of ONE payload; a larger one fails with reason spill.too-large.

maxTotalBytes.description: Byte ceiling of the whole directory; a purge trims to it, oldest file first.

maxAgeSeconds.description: Retention age in seconds (0 disables the age purge).

previewBytes.description: Bytes of the payload copied into the write answer as a preview.

purgeOnWrite.description: Run the retention policy on every write (best effort).
